def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    annual_returns = [5.2, 7.1, 2.8, 6.5, 3.9, 9.0, 4.6, 8.3, 5.7, 7.4]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    sorted_returns = sorted(annual_returns)

    middle_right = sorted_returns[len(sorted_returns) // 2]
    answer = round((middle_left + middle_right) / 2, 2)

    # return answer
